title: Shinonome Akito — Brand New Style〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Classmates A & B
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, what's with the synchronized sighing...?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Can't you tell that we're feeling depressed?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Yeah.
If only there were someone to listen to what's bothering us.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Fine, I'll bite...
What happened?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Seriously, what happened?!
How did I only grow three millimeters this past year?!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: They told me that I shrank two centimeters! I'm supposed to be a growing teenager!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, you're talking about when we got our measurements taken earlier?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Wait, why do you sound so calm...?
Please don't say that you grew...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Two centimeters.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, don't give me those looks...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I mean, I was surprised too.
But we're only talking about two centimeters here.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Only two centimeters?!
I shrank two centimeters! That puts me under 170!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Yeah, there's a huge difference between being above and below that number...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ah... Yeah, that is a huge difference.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Don't patronize us!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Akito! Gimme your legs...!
No, your torso! Five centimeters! That's all I ask!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Not happening...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Akito, are you there?
About practice after school...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sorry, was I interrupting...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Eh, kinda, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Come to think of it, did your class also just get measurements taken? What was your height?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My height? I grew a centimeter.

rows.Speaker: Classmates A & B
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
How is this fair?!
It's like only the tall ones get to keep growing!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I'm really starting to reconsider our relationship!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
No, that was a joke!
I didn't mean what I just said! Don't take it seriously!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Don't mind them. They're just griping about not growing as much as they'd hoped.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Guh...!
You're right, but this is still really frustrating...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's all true!
Sorry, Toya, you've done nothing wrong...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see...
Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: For a second there, I was worried that I'd overstepped a boundary and said or done something to offend you...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Argh...!
M-My poor heart...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I vaguely remember whining about my height and shoe size when I was still playing soccer...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Height I understand...
But why your shoe size?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Haven't you ever heard about how people with big feet are supposed to grow tall?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I have...
But that apparently has no scientific basis.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I didn't believe it either when I saw someone say that on TV.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: No, big feet means being able to support a large body! It's a sign that someone's ready to grow, right?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I thought the same thing.
But it's apparently normal to stop growing after your voice changes.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: No, that doesn't make any sense. You're still growing! Explain that!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Don't ask me...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, if you wanna grow taller, then why don't you make some changes to your current lifestyle? Staying up late playing video games probably isn't helping.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Urgh... I didn't come here to be lectured.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, Toya, sorry...
You were asking about practice after school, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
I'd forgotten how much fun it was to talk with everyone like this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Mind if I stop by during the next break? We can talk about practice then.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, I'll be waiting.
